source.description: RotorDin source supplied with the OP-W60 correlation campaign on 2026-09-09

lateral_convention_evidence.bearing_cross_terms: identity: RotorDin Kxz/Kzx,Cxz/Czx map directly to ROSS Kxy/Kyx,Cxy/Cyx
lateral_convention_evidence.ross_adapter_action: invert assembled G and reverse synchronous circular-force handedness; leave M/K/C and bearing coefficients unchanged

response_angle_contract.solver_expected_token: RANUN=D means degrees; default/other means radians
response_angle_contract.migrated_frontend_serialization: single-character RANUN is right-justified in A10
response_angle_contract.cadjf_bug: right-justified one-character RANUN is reduced to blank by cadjf(cin,1), so response defaults to radians
response_angle_contract.validation: manually left-justifying D makes the supplied solver use degrees; the resulting table equals the orthogonal rotation of the bug-compatible complex channels from raw 45 rad to 45 deg within numerical precision

known_legacy_contract_note: The committed golden CSV reproduces the current migrated RotorDin frontend bug-compatible path: raw probe orientation 45 is interpreted as 45 rad because right-justified RANUN is lost by cadjf. ROSS Studio production uses the intended physical DEGREES contract. Bug-compatible radians remain available only for regression/correlation diagnostics.
